findings.title: Hardcoded Django SECRET_KEY
findings.fix: Load SECRET_KEY from an environment variable / secrets manager, not a literal.

findings.title: Hardcoded Django SECRET_KEY
findings.fix: Load SECRET_KEY from an environment variable / secrets manager, not a literal.

findings.title: Raw HTML injection via dangerouslySetInnerHTML
findings.fix: Sanitise HTML (e.g. DOMPurify) before rendering, or render as text.

findings.title: DEBUG = True
findings.fix: Ensure DEBUG=False in any non-local settings; DEBUG leaks tracebacks + data.

findings.title: Empty ALLOWED_HOSTS
findings.fix: Set ALLOWED_HOSTS explicitly for any deployed instance.

findings.title: DEBUG = True
findings.fix: Ensure DEBUG=False in any non-local settings; DEBUG leaks tracebacks + data.

findings.title: django: version floor allows vulnerable releases
findings.fix: Raise the lower bound to >= 4.2. 3.2 is end-of-life; floor allows unpatched releases.

findings.title: Live: response missing strict-transport-security header
findings.detail: strict-transport-security not sent by the server
findings.fix: Send the strict-transport-security header (via middleware / nginx).

findings.title: djangorestframework: version floor allows vulnerable releases
findings.fix: Raise the lower bound to >= 3.15.2. older DRF browsable API had reflected-XSS CVEs.

findings.title: requests: version floor allows vulnerable releases
findings.fix: Raise the lower bound to >= 2.32.0. older requests have credential-leak CVEs (e.g. CVE-2024-35195).

findings.title: Live: response missing content-security-policy header
findings.detail: content-security-policy not sent by the server
findings.fix: Send the content-security-policy header (via middleware / nginx).
